hypothesis: A directly programmed fixed 512-bit/3-hash binary association weight array can recognize all 13 witnessed source Q-P-Q memberships with 0 false negatives, <=1% false-positive membership on the fully enumerated finite source-ID/source-PID candidate universe, and byte-exact cold restore at 64 programmed bytes. It does not learn from gradients and cannot enumerate objects, delete facts or infer unobserved causal laws.
representation: 512-bit weight array; each allowed Q/P/Q numeric ID triple uint32 packed little endian; deterministic BLAKE2b-128 person='QTRF34' yields first three 32-bit little-endian slots mod 512; set membership bits for each of 13 source triples. No tokenization.

controls.exact_sparse: 13 sorted 3xuint32 triplets at 156 bytes, no false positives, can enumerate results; strongest exact-membership control.
controls.shuffled: Deterministic source-object permutation with actual object IDs, to show same identity-weight program cannot be credited for a different association assignment.
controls.unseen: Finite cartesian product of all source observed QIDs for subjects+objects and all source observed PIDs, excluding the 13 admitted source triples. This is 'unknown to frozen source' only, not globally false real-world facts.
controls.cold: Canonical 64-byte weight snapshot restored in new object exactly reproduces query results.
controls.additive_interference: Add 3 deterministic in-universe non-source triples, verify zero old-positive loss and report new false-positive count; these are synthetic controls only and never admitted source facts.

cost_scope: Reports standalone bit-array payload only; hash CPU/time, source labels, source receipts, inability to enumerate, deletions and global quality are separate costs/limitations. No claim of better end-to-end performance.
science_fence: DEV direct bit-weight coding feasibility, NOT SCIENTIFIC_PASS or recipient-native weight integration or learned reasoning/transfer. No protected original-source first-use.
authority: Contributor QTR source-only new file, first-party source already persisted; no extra API calls, no user Library attachments, no model or controller changes, no merge or deployment.
stop: If FPR >1%, old-positive fails, cold loss, cross-platform source digest differs or negative control accidentally duplicates source positives: preserve NO_GO without retuning bit count/hash functions after observation.
